title: The isolated pawn
line: No pawns of its own beside it: block it, trade pieces, then win it.

steps.text: Black's pawn on d5 has no black pawn on a file next to it: an isolated pawn. Only pieces can guard it now.
Tap the square right in front of the isolated pawn. No black pawn can guard it now.
steps.hint: The pawn moves down the board. Look one square below it.
steps.after: White's knight sits there. It blocks the pawn, and no black pawn can attack it there now.

steps.text: With most pieces traded, the pawn is a target. Only pieces can guard it, and in an ending the king joins the attack.
Put your king on the square in front of the pawn. It attacks the pawn, and no black pawn can attack it there.

wrong.b5d5: Black's rook takes back, and you have given a rook for a pawn.

steps.hint: Your king steps toward the pawn, onto the file it stands on.
steps.after: Black's rook leaves to look for play elsewhere, and now nothing guards the isolated pawn.

steps.text: Nothing guards the isolated pawn now. Take it with the rook.
steps.after: The isolated pawn falls, a pawn for nothing.

summary: An isolated pawn can be guarded only by pieces. Block the square in front of it, trade pieces, then win it.
